check_kinds.mechanical: Decided by the validator from artifact content (schema, ids, trace, hashes).
check_kinds.execution: The validator executed a command itself and recorded evidence.
check_kinds.ai_review: Semantic review written by the vmodel:verifier subagent. Recorded with machine_verified=false; the validator only checks that it exists, targets the current manifest hash and approves.

gates.name: Requirements

checks.desc: requirements.json exists and matches the schema
REQ/AC ids well formed and unique across the project
every active functional requirement has at least one acceptance criterion
conflict analysis performed; every conflict resolved; referenced ids exist
no open critical issue; resolved critical issues decided by the user
requirements changed since the last PASS are covered by a change request
vague wording warning (never blocks)
verifier review approves the current manifest hash, no open major finding; the review must be registered in the signed ledger with 'vmodel review-submit' (verifier only)

gates.pass_criteria: all checks pass (warnings allowed); pending review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED by vmodel:verifier; open critical issue -> REVIEW_REQUIRED by user

gates.name: Architecture

checks.desc: architecture.json exists and matches the schema
ARCH/IF ids well formed and unique across the project
every active functional requirement is mapped to a component; no dangling requirement references
interfaces defined when there are 2+ components; providers/consumers exist
every active non-functional requirement is addressed in nfr_mapping
integration test strategy exists and covers every interface
design trade-offs recorded (warning only)

verifier review approves the current manifest hash; the review must be registered in the signed ledger with 'vmodel review-submit' (verifier only); a work item without interfaces also records integration_applicability (decision not_required, reason, endpoints_reviewed), which only G6 uses for N/A (not part of the G2 decision)

gates.pass_criteria: all checks pass; pending review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED by vmodel:verifier

gates.name: Detailed Design & Test Planning

agents.author: orchestrator using agents/detailed-designer.md; vmodel:test-designer subagent for tests.json

checks.desc: design.json and tests.json exist and match the schemas
DESIGN/TEST ids well formed and unique across the project
every component has a design unit; every functional requirement reaches a design unit
signature, pre/postconditions, explicit error list and boundary conditions per unit
every unit has unit tests: normal, abnormal for declared errors, boundary for declared boundaries
integration test spec per interface; system test spec per acceptance criterion
test references exist; every functional requirement is covered by a test
DESIGN/TEST ids removed since the last PASS are listed in a CR or defect removed_ids

verifier review (design + test adequacy) approves the current manifest hash; the review must be registered in the signed ledger with 'vmodel review-submit' (verifier only); a work item without integration test specs also records integration_applicability, which only G6 uses for N/A (not part of the G3 decision)

gates.pass_criteria: all checks pass; pending review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED by vmodel:verifier

gates.name: Implementation

manifest.notes: code gates hash every project file except VCS/tool/venv dirs and __pycache__ bytecode, plus .vmodel/config.json, defects.json and change-requests.json

checks.desc: source and test files exist under the configured paths
no Python file outside configured source/tests/build_config/other paths; no symlinks
built-in Python AST syntax check of all source and test files
configured static analyzer executed by the validator; missing tool -> BLOCKED unless the user configured syntax-only
each design unit's module exists and defines the designed symbol
every unit and integration TEST id has a test function (AST) whose name carries exactly that one TEST_nnn token
every functional requirement reaches an implemented symbol
only with interfaces: the def/class named in each IF signature is defined in a design unit module of the provider component (unreadable signature -> warning, the G4 review's provider_symbols decide)

only with integration test specs: per integration test and interface, a call path from the test function (helpers and fixtures, depth 3) into the provider (and ARCH consumer) modules (path A), or a runtime integration mechanism (subprocess, IPC, API, dynamic import: path B) declared by the verifier in the G4 review with the test file hash (pending until declared); placeholder tests without calls and tests with neither path fail; provider patching warns
test/support code defines no pytest result hooks and does not touch exit status, junit or os._exit; no reference to the G6 runtime trace (VMODEL_TRACE)

verifier code review + test code adequacy review of the current code hash; the review must be registered in the signed ledger with 'vmodel review-submit' (verifier only); with interfaces the review lists every IF in 'interfaces' (result ok/issue, provider_symbols defined in the provider modules, runtime_paths for path B tests); missing or malformed -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, issue -> FAILED

gates.pass_criteria: all checks pass; pending review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED by vmodel:verifier; file hashes recorded

gates.name: Unit Verification
inputs: G4 manifest (requirements, design, tests spec, source, test code, config)

agents.author: validator (executes tests itself)
agents.reviewer: none (mechanical); test adequacy is reviewed at G3/G4

manifest.notes: code gates hash every project file except VCS/tool/venv dirs and __pycache__ bytecode, plus .vmodel/config.json, defects.json and change-requests.json

checks.desc: G4 PASSED for the current manifest hash
validator runs the unit test command itself with a scrubbed environment (no PYTHON*/PYTEST_* from the agent, no bytecode, plugin autoload off unless configured); exit code 0; junit produced
tests > 0, failures = 0, errors = 0
every unit TEST id has a passed test case (named with exactly one id) and no failed/skipped case
only when integration_test is configured: the unit run executes no integration-level TEST id (fail) and no system-level id (warning); levels come from every work item's tests.json
every functional requirement is linked to a passed test
changed/removed test files justified in test_changes; previously executed TEST ids still executed (when integration_test is configured, ids that are integration level now are left to G6)
verified files did not change during the test run

gates.name: Integration Verification
inputs: G5 manifest (architecture interfaces, tests spec, source, test code, config)
reviews/G2.json, reviews/G3.json (N/A confirmation), reviews/G4.json (declared runtime paths)
outputs: integration test execution evidence (stdout/stderr/junit, hashes, environment, runtime trace, interface reach) or a recorded N/A decision

agents.author: validator (executes the configured integration_test command itself)
agents.reviewer: none (mechanical); interface wiring and integration test adequacy are reviewed at G4, N/A reasons at G2/G3

manifest.notes: the G5 code manifest plus the G2/G3/G4 review files G6 relies on; adding G6 changes no G1-G5 manifest

checks.desc: G5 PASSED for the current manifest

required when there is an interface or an integration test spec; not_applicable only when there are none, one component without data flows to another ARCH id, the G2 and G3 reviews accepted by the current PASSes confirm integration_applicability (all external endpoints) and interfaces of earlier G2 PASSes are in a CR/DEFECT removed_ids; otherwise BLOCKED applicability_unconfirmed
integration_test is configured (argv with {junit}, positive timeout_s); missing or invalid -> BLOCKED misconfigured, nothing is executed and the unit command is never used instead
validator runs the integration test command itself with a scrubbed environment and its runtime tracer; exit code 0; junit produced
tests > 0, failures = 0, errors = 0
the integration run executes no unit-level TEST id (fail); system-level ids warn
every integration TEST id has a passed test case (named with exactly one id) and no failed/skipped case

every interface is test-level verified: a passed integration test whose function ran, with a call path into the interface (path A: the validator's own static call analysis; path B: a runtime path declared at G4), and whose own execution shows the connection in the runtime trace (path A: a provider function ran with an architecture consumer function on its call stack, or on the stack that started its thread / submitted its pool work item; EXTERNAL consumer: a provider function ran in that test; path B: the provider ran during the test call, in another process for subprocess/ipc, and the consumer ran in it). Evidence from other tests, the whole run (suite-level) or no trace never covers an interface -> BLOCKED integration_evidence_insufficient; no call path -> FAILED
integration TEST ids executed by the baseline G6 run and interfaces of earlier G2 PASSes are still there, or listed in a CR/DEFECT removed_ids
verified files did not change during the run

gates.pass_criteria: required: every check passes on this run's own evidence, the validator's own static analysis and runtime trace; not_applicable: only when every N/A condition is confirmed (recorded PASSED with applicability=not_applicable, shown as N/A, nothing executed, never counted as defect verification); unconfirmed applicability, missing/invalid integration_test or insufficient runtime evidence -> BLOCKED

manifest.notes: code gates hash every project file except VCS/tool/venv dirs and __pycache__ bytecode, plus .vmodel/config.json, defects.json and change-requests.json

checks.desc: [EXT] run system/acceptance tests
[EXT] every acceptance criterion verified by a passed system test

LITE.notes: [EXT] small fixes and bug fixes; impact analysis focused; G2 may be N/A with a recorded reason; code change and tests mandatory

STANDARD.notes: implements G1-G6; a work item that passes G1-G6 (G6 PASSED or N/A) is PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, never COMPLETED, until G7 exists

STRICT.notes: [EXT] all gates, user approval at G1, two independent reviews at G4, coverage threshold at G5
